# Specialty Rx Consulting Group

> > Specialty Rx Consulting Group provides independent pharmacy consulting services focused on inventory management, procurement strategies, and net profit optimization.

This blog serves as a resource for independent pharmacies seeking to reduce costs and improve business operations through strategic wholesale distribution partnerships and expense management solutions. The firm is associated with the National Community Pharmacy Association and offers specialized consulting through SpecRxGroup.com.

## Key Topics

- Independent pharmacy management
- Inventory management strategies
- Procurement optimization
- Pharmacy consulting services
- Cost reduction techniques
- Net profit optimization
- Wholesale distribution
- Business operations improvement
- Pharmacy expense management
- National Community Pharmacy Association
- SpecRxGroup.com
- Specialty pharmacy solutions

## Core Services & Information

- [Specialty Rx Consulting Group Homepage](https://specialtyrxconsultinggroup.blogspot.com/): Homepage for pharmacy consulting services & wholesale distribution
- [We Tip the Scales in Your Favor](https://specialtyrxconsultinggroup.blogspot.com/2018/10/we-tip-scales-in-your-favor-s-pecialty.html): Independent pharmacy expense management & procurement strategies
